## Skill submission

**Skill name:**
**File:** `submissions/<slug>.md`

## Checklist

- [ ] I copied `submissions/_TEMPLATE.md` to `submissions/<slug>.md` and the `slug` field matches the file name.
- [ ] All front matter fields are filled in: `name`, `slug`, `description`, `connectors`, `license`, `source`, `author`, `lastTested`.
- [ ] The `## Skill text` section contains the full skill.
- [ ] The skill is publicly available at the `source` URL.
- [ ] The skill is under an open license (for example MIT or CC0) that allows SkillShelf to redistribute it.
- [ ] I wrote this skill, or I have the right to submit it and have credited the original author.
- [ ] I tested the skill recently and `lastTested` reflects that date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- [ ] The submission contains no email addresses, API keys, or other private information.
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Notes (optional)

Anything reviewers should know: required setup, known limitations, example prompts, etc.
